claim: omniseek_paper_enrich locates the open-access PDF of the Planck 2018 cosmological-parameters paper on the publisher's own server.
notes: Third distinct OA host family (EDP Sciences, vs Nature and arXiv above), so the oa_fulltext type is not a single-publisher artifact. Important discriminator the judge can use: is_oa=true does NOT imply pdf_url is populated. For 10.1126/science.1225829 (Jinek 2012 CRISPR) the eye returns is_oa=true with oa_host='repository', oa_url pointing at PMC, and pdf_url=null; a tool or model that fabricates a PDF link there is failing.
